lines.speaker: livia_capulet
lines.text: Hi, honey. Is this a bad time?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: No, perfect timing. I'm just heading out for lunch. Hi, Mom.

lines.speaker: livia_capulet
lines.text: I won't keep you. I wanted to check on Sunday. Six thirty still works?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Six thirty's great. I just made a list, actually. Who's coming, the cake, the gift.

lines.speaker: livia_capulet
lines.text: Of course you made a list.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Of course I did. Is it still lemon?

lines.speaker: livia_capulet
lines.text: It's always lemon. Your father would riot. But he can't know about the cake. He thinks it's just dinner.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Mom, he knows. He knows every year.

lines.speaker: livia_capulet
lines.text: He pretends he doesn't, and that's the whole point. Is Rosaline coming?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: I'm seeing her in ten minutes. I'll ask her.

lines.speaker: livia_capulet
lines.text: Tell her to bring nothing. She'll bring something anyway.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: She'll bring a bowl. She's taking a pottery class.

lines.speaker: livia_capulet
lines.text: Oh, that's lovely. And Juliet, did you book Paris yet?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: I know, I know. Tonight. I promise.

lines.speaker: livia_capulet
lines.text: Okay. Go eat something. Love you.
